ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation RUNDLL LAUNCHER - PowerShell Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via RUNDLL LAUNCHER Note: Unmapped fields: Payload

sequences.query: (Payload = RGX(".*rundll32\\\.exe.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*shellexec\\_rundll.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*powershell.*"))
